{"address":"141c0fe90","function_name":"CheckActorWorldBounds","comment":"Check actor lifetime, world bounds and kill height, invoking native out-of-world behavior when required.

Algorithm:
1. Reject an indexed pending-kill actor or null owner virtual138 world.
2. Resolve settings through1421BC760(world,true,true), including its first streaming-level override; return true if settings390 bit0 disables bounds checks.
3. Read root168 translation, or global FVectorZero at14418AC48/50 for a null root. Below settings394 kill height, dispatch actor508 with the selected damage type and return false.
4. Otherwise, for a registered nonnull root compare bounds against the native world limit. On failure dispatch actor510, disable collision141C29400 and physics141C12630, then return false. All remaining paths return true.

Rollback dependency:
142028750 invokes owner virtual410 from body-output processing, even when its pose-tolerance test skips component movement. The admitted LuxWorldSettings410 slot targets this function. Null owner root168 removes chunk transform reads but does not by itself prove an inert callback: the zero-height branch can still invoke508 when kill height is above it (or unordered). Preserve native calls and validate the relevant owner/world/settings conditions before excluding chunk motion. Number of active body outputs can change when visual physics changes.

Parameters:
  pActor: void * - raw native actor, complete layout not recovered here.
Returns:
  bool in AL; true inside admitted world bounds, false for invalid/world-exit paths.
Special Cases:
Native bounds-disabled early return ignores root pose and kill height. Null-root position uses the live global zero vector, not an assumed numeric constant. This annotation does not close collision, reflection, lifecycle or recovery policy."}
